## Objective
- Build a complete, playable game inspired by “Muse for Meta,” with no predefined boundaries.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Interpreted the request as an infinite, creative exploration game: “MUSE — NO EDGES,” with optional echo collection rather than a required finish line.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built a playable, responsive browser game with infinite procedural scenery, exploration, collectible echoes, creation tools, touch controls, help, and local save state.
- Verified `game.js` syntax and tested desktop/mobile rendering and basic creation in Chromium; no console errors after adding a favicon.

### Active
- Final browser retest is unfinished: a help-button test timed out because the welcome overlay was still open and correctly intercepted clicks.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. If desired, retest help by clicking “STEP INTO THE OPEN” first, then the help button.
2. Summarize the implementation and assumptions for the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, controls, and welcome/help dialogs.
- `style.css`: Visual design and responsive/mobile layouts.
- `game.js`: Game loop, procedural world, movement, tools, echoes, and persistence.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local static server was started on port `3002`; browser testing used `playwright-cli`.
